action.objective: Advance f-pawn to f3, attacking the g4 bishop and gaining tempo.
action.rationale: f2f3 is the only commit_ready move: exact depth-3 score 51, safety complete with no mating reply, tactical_refutation not_found. It attacks the g4 bishop (attacks_after e4,g4); Black's Bxf3 is possible but the bishop would then be exposed to recapture, and the broad depth-4 search ranked it top among all root moves.
